questions.markdown: A 0.18-$\mu$m fabrication process is specified to have $t_{ox}=4\,\text{nm}$, $\mu_n=450\,\text{cm}^2/\text{Vs}$ and $V_T=0.5\,\text{V}$. Find the value of $C_{ox}$ and $\mu_n C_{ox}$. For a MOSFET with minimum length $L=0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ fabricated in this process, find the required value of $W$ so that the device exhibits a channel resistance of $1\,\text{k}\Omega$ at $V_{GS}=1\,\text{V}$. Given $\varepsilon_{ox}=3.45\times 10^{-11}\,\text{F/m}$.

Calculate the values of Overdrive voltage $V_{OV}$, Gate Source Voltage $V_{GS}$ and minimum Drain Source Voltage $V_{DSmin}$, needed to operate the transistor in saturation region with a dc current of $I_D=60\,\mu\text{A}$.
